purpose: Development comparison of one agent versus the existing coordinator team on matched cases, budgets, tools, memory and human policy. Supporting evidence only; not the instructor's evaluation.

c07-structured-release.note: release.json is compared as canonical JSON; the notes file is checked only for a heading and one title.

c07-text-word-counts.note: counts.json is compared as canonical JSON against hand-computed counts; summary.md is checked only for its heading.

c07-python-slugify.note: Checks that the source declares slugify and that examples.json matches hand-computed outputs. The code is never executed, so program correctness is not established.

c07-correction-total.note: Exact bytes including the single trailing newline; a wrong first proposal receives trusted verification feedback and can be repaired.
